say: Land records are flat.
Cities... aren't.
Bhoo-aah-yaam.
The three-D property registry.
One flat. Three records. Three different answers.
Today, an officer reconciles them by hand.
So, drop in anything.
Every original is sealed on arrival.
Unfamiliar data? AI reads it, byte by byte,
and proposes what each field means.
Code converts. Nothing is invented.
AI normalises the first chunks, while a model learns from each one.
Then the model takes over. Faster.
And the city streams onto the map, while it's still uploading.
Search any building, and fly straight to it.
Every value cites its source.
Every floor. Every flat. Its own three-D ULPIN.
Read straight from the documents.
Plan and survey disagree? See it, in place.
One click, and it's a finding.
Below the parcel, too. Water, sewer, gas.
Draw a trench, see what it crosses.
Every flat gets a Property Card, that anyone can verify.
Same revision. Same hash chain.
Built for the officer.
Open to the citizen.
Identify.
Prove.
Govern.
Bhoo-aah-yaam.
Every floor. Every flat. One verifiable record.
